name: The Roving Office
description: Publishes OpenClaw agent activity to a Roving Office receiver as Agent Office Protocol events.

url.description: Ingest URL of the office, e.g. https://office.example.com/office/ab12cd34/aop/v0/events. Overrides AOP_URL and ~/.roving-office/endpoint.json.

token.description: Write token for that office. Sent as X-Roving-Office-Token.

scene.description: Force every session into one office, whatever repo it is in. Same effect as ROVING_OFFICE_SCENE.

wrappedHarness.description: Slug of the harness OpenClaw is wrapping here (claude-code, codex-cli). Stamped on ext.wrapped_harness so the office can de-duplicate against that harness's own adapter.

heartbeatMs.description: Heartbeat interval for live sessions. Default 15000, per AOP spec §4.1.

lingerMs.description: How long a batch waits for company before being posted. Default 250.

enabled.description: Set false to load the plugin but publish nothing.
